basis: Container facts are labelled P (final primary text), P-draft (public MPEG drafts w23813 and w18310 with COR1), S (ExifTool 13.55 source) and N (native 13.55 observation on hand-built fixtures). Nothing here claims pixel identity, authenticity, privacy, MWG conformance or exhaustive ExifTool coverage.

slots.iptc: IFD0 tag 0x83BB or Photoshop resource 0x0404 of tag 0x8649

protected: every IFD entry value except pointer and slot tags
every strip, tile and JPEG-interchange extent by index, length and bytes
allowedChanges: planned IFD0, ExifIFD and GPS targets
closed native side effects of the container
nativeSideEffects: extent offset tag values (StripOffsets, TileOffsets) change because the writer relocates image data

recipes.others: named keys from the trusted listing of the capture

thumbnails.reason: an IFD1 in a TIFF is a page

slots.iptc: IFD0 tag 0x83BB or Photoshop resource 0x0404 of tag 0x8649

protected: every tag of every DNG image IFD except pointer and slot tags (colour, calibration, opcode, level and crop tags included)
raw and preview extents by index, length and bytes
allowedChanges: planned IFD0, ExifIFD and GPS targets
closed native side effects of the container
nativeSideEffects: extent offset tag values (StripOffsets, TileOffsets) change because the writer relocates image data

recipes.deviceIdentity: named serial-number keys only; MakerNote and DNGPrivateData are never deleted

thumbnails.reason: preview IFDs are protected image data

protected: every critical chunk in order (IDAT per chunk)
every ancillary chunk that is not a metadata slot or text chunk, whole and in order
text chunks other than XMP unless a removal category selects them by keyword
allowedChanges: insert, replace or remove eXIf before the first IDAT
insert, replace or remove the XMP iTXt before the first IDAT

recipes.exif: category removals: named keys from the trusted listing of the capture; minimise (AM-19): -EXIF:all= (the E2 closed reset, only when the Exif block holds more than the kept rendering values) and then the exact keep-set write-back as numeric assignments, for example -IFD0:Orientation#=6, with the capture's -ExifByteOrder=
recipes.text: PNG:<Keyword> keys the locator reports as tEXt, zTXt or iTXt

minimise.rule: AM-17 semantics with the AM-19 method: the Exif block is reset with -EXIF:all= (only when it holds more than the kept values), the XMP block with -XMP:all= and every PNG text chunk by its PNG:<Keyword> key, never -all= or -PNG:all=; the independently read E2 keep-set (Exif Orientation, YCbCrPositioning, ColorSpace, InteropIndex) is written back with numeric assignments such as -IFD0:Orientation#=6 and the capture's -ExifByteOrder=; refused with MINIMISE_RENDERING_UNPRESERVED when a keep-set value cannot be kept faithfully; the closed residual proof, the native closed diff and the byte-level protection of gamma, colour profile and image data stay authoritative

webp.detect: RIFF header with WEBP form type at byte 8
protected: VP8X canvas and the I, L and A flags
ICCP, ANIM, every ANMF, ALPH, VP8, VP8L and unknown chunks, padding bytes included, in order
allowedChanges: EXIF and XMP chunk insert, replace or remove after the image data
VP8X creation or removal only as predicted and proved by the AM-16R rules

recipes.exif: category removals: named keys from the trusted listing of the capture; minimise (AM-19): -EXIF:all= (the E2 closed reset, only when the Exif block holds more than the kept rendering values) and then the exact keep-set write-back as numeric assignments, for example -IFD0:Orientation#=6, with the capture's -ExifByteOrder=

minimise.rule: AM-17 semantics with the AM-19 method: the Exif block is reset with -EXIF:all= (only when it holds more than the kept values) and the XMP block with -XMP:all=, never -all=; the independently read E2 keep-set (Exif Orientation, YCbCrPositioning, ColorSpace, InteropIndex) is written back with numeric assignments such as -IFD0:YCbCrPositioning#=2 and the capture's -ExifByteOrder=; refused with MINIMISE_RENDERING_UNPRESERVED when a keep-set value cannot be kept faithfully; the closed residual proof, the native closed diff, the AM-16R layout proof and the byte-level protection of ICC, alpha, animation and image data stay authoritative

heif.detect: ftyp box at byte 4 with brand heic, heix, mif1 or avif

slots.exif: Exif item linked to the primary image by iref cdsc
slots.xmp: mime item application/rdf+xml linked by iref cdsc

protected: whole infe box and reassembled payload of every item that is not a primary-image metadata slot
every iref entry except cdsc entries from slot items
other meta children and top-level boxes other than ftyp, meta, mdat, free and skip
allowedChanges: slot item payloads with their iinf, iloc and cdsc entries

removal.reason: native all= leaves Exif and XMP items with extent_length 0, which resolves to the image payload

bigtiff.reason: BigTIFF is not writable by ExifTool 13.55

makerRaw.reason: maker TIFF variants have image and maker structures that cannot be protected generally
